document.outcome: Create or edit the requested document with the appropriate authoring surface.

skills.name: spreadsheets
skills.when: Spreadsheet files, formulas, recalculation or analysis.

skills.name: pdf
skills.when: PDF reading, creation, forms or layout verification; resolve any variant.

skills.name: excel-live-control
skills.when: An established connected live Excel task is explicitly requested.

inputs: Actual file or connected session, requested edits, target format and source evidence.
steps: Select file artifact, native workspace or live session before choosing the leaf.
Use that leaf's authoring and render/recalculation requirements.
document.check: Render/inspect documents; recalculate and validate spreadsheet values/formulas; inspect editable slides.
document.stop: Requested artifact checked or exact unsupported session/tool is named.
document.boundary: Local preparation within the existing task authorization.

workspace.outcome: Operate a connected workspace using its task-specific plugin skill.

skills.name: google-drive
skills.when: Drive is the entry point for connected Drive/Docs/Sheets/Slides work.

skills.name: plugin-management
skills.when: An explicitly needed integration is unavailable and plugin discovery is requested/useful.

skills.name: notion-knowledge-capture
skills.when: Save durable supplied knowledge into Notion.

skills.name: sites
skills.when: User requests building/managing a Site through Sites.

inputs: Named service, actual tools, selected sources/destination and requested operation.
steps: Find the exact plugin skill with catalog search.
Check live tool availability; cached manifests do not connect accounts.
Use the relevant leaf and its exact scope.
workspace.check: Read back the actual authorized result through the connector.
workspace.stop: Requested change/answer checked or exact missing integration remains.
workspace.boundary: Reading a page does not authorize saving/reorganizing; no new sharing or recurring jobs implied.

pet.outcome: Operate an explicitly requested ChatGPT animated pet.

skills.name: create-pet
skills.when: Create a new ChatGPT Work animated pet.

skills.name: pets
skills.when: List, inspect, select or delete an established ChatGPT pet.

inputs: Explicit ChatGPT pet context, selected character/assets and live plugin tools.
steps: Follow exact sprite/animation validation and plugin contract.
pet.check: Use the leaf's animation states, directions and live result checks.
pet.stop: Requested pet operation checked or missing tool/assets named.
pet.boundary: Do not route real-world pets or another app's mascot into ChatGPT Pets.
